[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Halpern''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed aboard [[Adamas Space Station]], orbiting the planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Around [[3642 BBY]], he asked an Imperial traveler to take a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to the surface and talk to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vannis]] about the ongoing [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TLWB" />
